author: Hawaadli
attribution: Photo: Hawaadli, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Salam_Baku_sign_in_F1_Village_entertainment_zone_in_Baku.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
